hero.title: Connect your business. Understand what is happening. Decide what to do next.
hero.description: Connection Pilot brings the important parts of your small business into one operating workspace, with Pilot helping you keep priorities clear.

stepOne.title: 1. Bring your day-to-day work together
stepOne.description: Manage customers, leads, orders and jobs, scheduling, employees, quotes, invoices, payments, and inventory directly in Connection Pilot.
stepOne.customerMessage: A customer needs a follow-up, a job needs scheduling, and an invoice needs review.

stepTwo.title: 2. Connection Pilot keeps the context connected
stepTwo.description: Instead of switching between systems, your workspace keeps the customer, work, schedule, and financial context close together.

messages.text: You have two open leads, one job waiting for confirmation, and an invoice due for review.
What should I focus on first?
Start with the high-value job confirmation, then review the two leads that need follow-up.

stepThree.title: 3. Pilot helps you understand what needs attention
stepThree.description: Pilot uses the business context in your workspace to surface useful priorities, questions, risks, and opportunities for the owner to review.

stepFour.title: 4. Make the next decision with the full picture
stepFour.description: Review the organized details, choose the next step, and keep the team moving without losing the context behind the work.

stepFive.title: 5. You stay in control
stepFive.description: Pilot is the intelligence layer, not the decision-maker. It helps you understand what is happening and decide what to do next.
stepFive.controlNote: Connection Pilot is built to support the business owner’s judgement, not replace it.
stepFive.humanText: Use the connected workspace and Pilot’s context to decide the action that is right for your customers and business.

cta.title: Run your entire business with Pilot.
cta.description: Start with the work you have today and build your Connection Pilot workspace from there.
